description:
DEBLOAT METHOD (validated on a worked example this session).

The bloat is three kinds, each with a different action:
- DUPLICATE -> consolidate to one home + point. Example: the bw cookbook is TRIPLICATED (MAJOR_POLYBIUS 7.3 ~32 lines, MAJOR_PLINY 6.1 ~34 lines, operating-disciplines 12 ~77 lines); the two role-file copies are near-verbatim and already drifting. Fix: delete the role-file copies, keep op-disc 12, leave a one-line pointer.
- ALWAYS-INLINE (one agent, always needs it) -> keep inline. Extraction buys NOTHING here (it would be in context either way, plus indirection). Extraction only pays off across MANY consumers (DRY) or for CONDITIONAL knowledge (lazy-load). This is the key correction: for always-needed single-consumer knowledge, inline wins.
- CONDITIONAL (needed only sometimes) -> move to on-demand reference. Examples in POLYBIUS: 5 onboarding (~220), 10 sub-project (~100), 11+12 pair-programmer (~168), 14 substrate-check.

Cross-cutting CONTENT TIERS (currently mashed together in each section):
- operational core: the rule, stated crisply -> always-loaded, small.
- reference: detailed procedures for paths that fire sometimes -> on-demand.
- provenance: why each rule exists, which ticket, the empirical story -> archived in bw, CITED not inlined. The "N=1 provenance + accretion path" + "Cross-references" subsections in 4 / 16-19 are tier-3 sitting in the always-loaded path.

WORKED EXAMPLE (4.3.1 PRINCIPAL-intent probe): ~17 lines -> ~5. Rule + 3-step probe sequence stays; the 2026-05-13 four-options empirical story moves to a bw show stoa--ezj cite.

LINE MATH (POLYBIUS 1299): ~500 lines conditional -> reference; ~330 provenance -> bw cites; ~30+ duplicate -> delete. Leaves ~300-350 operational core. NOTHING LOST - relocated by access pattern.
title: Method: 3-bucket debloat (duplicate/always-inline/conditional) + 3-tier content model
